name: 米白画册
still: Matte off-white uncoated paper with subtle fiber texture, like a page of a printed jewelry catalogue, a thin shadow line where the paper curves.
wear: Ivory or oatmeal fine-knit top, plain light warm-grey backdrop, no other jewelry.
light: Soft diffused daylight, cool neutral white (not yellow), airy and light, gentle shadows.
note: 亮一点、干净的画册感，适合浅色珍珠和清透的水晶。
